description: A minimal portable requirement-to-plan handoff used to verify Claude source and generated Codex skills share the same JSON contracts.

document.statement: Keep durable lifecycle handoffs portable across supported agent harnesses.
document.why: A workflow must survive a handoff between Claude and Codex without relying on prompt-local state.
done_when: A valid requirement can be consumed by the research stage in either harness.
out_of_scope: Proving equivalent model judgment or prose.

document.question: Which contract must cross a Claude-to-Codex research-to-spec handoff?

findings.claim: The versioned JSON schema is the portable handoff boundary.

document.recommendation: Pass a research-report@1 document rather than a harness-specific agent transcript.

document.purpose: Define the portable contract check for the core lifecycle handoff.
document.scope: The requirement, research, specification, and plan contracts used by both harnesses.
non_goals: Comparing harness-specific prompts or named agents.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The artifact validates against its versioned JSON schema.

document.goal: Verify a portable lifecycle handoff before release.
document.architecture: Read the persisted specification and validate the compatibility fixture in CI.
